name: motu-skills
description: MotuArt Color Engine agent skills — AI portrait color grading and skin segmentation.

plugins.name: motu-color-engine
plugins.description: AI portrait color grading and skin segmentation via the MotuArt Color Engine API. Grade portraits with a film/commercial look, or export a skin mask.

plugins.name: motu-video-minimax-h3
plugins.description: Generate videos through the motu.art MiniMax Hailuo H3 workflow API — text-to-video, image-to-video, image+audio talking-head lip-sync, start/end-frame, and frames+audio video with structured shot-by-shot prompting.

plugins.name: motu-minimax-music3
plugins.description: Generate music through the motu.art MiniMax Music 3 workflow API — instrumental tracks and full songs with vocals from a structured style brief plus optional lyrics.

plugins.name: motu-ideogram4
plugins.description: Generate images through the motu.art Ideogram 4 workflow API — photos, illustrations, logos, posters, and images with readable rendered text.

plugins.name: motu-remove-watermark
plugins.description: Remove watermarks, logos, timestamps, and text overlays from images through the motu.art workflow API — inpaints marked regions and returns a clean image.

plugins.name: motu-qwen-image2-1
plugins.description: Generate images through the motu.art Qwen Image 2.1 workflow API — strongest on-image Chinese and English text rendering, native 512-2048 canvases, intent-matched prose prompt templates, and multi-image series with character consistency.

plugins.name: motu-z-image
plugins.description: Generate high-quality 2K images through the motu.art Z-Image Turbo workflow API — intent-matched prompt templates, per-image prompt design and verification, multi-image series with character consistency.
